role.roleTitle: Credit Risk Data Scientist, Consumer Lending

evidence.text: Engineered bureau and open-banking affordability features for the personal-loan application scorecard at Granby Finance, working in Python with logistic regression and weight-of-evidence binning.
Validated the scorecard on an out-of-time sample of 2022 applications, reporting a Gini coefficient of 0.58 and a population stability index of 0.04 against the development sample.
Wrote the model development document for independent validation; the validation team closed its review with two minor findings, both resolved before sign-off.
Rebuilt the application score, which lowered 90-day delinquencies by 18 basis points and saved the business millions in charge-offs.
Produced the monthly monitoring pack for the scorecard, covering population stability, characteristic stability and approval rates by score band.
